1. (Currently amended) An apparatus, comprising: an encoder (300) for encoding mode mapping information for a mapping between values of a mode index and modes available to encode at least a portion of a picture in a sequence of pictures, wherein the mode mapping information is adapted responsive to one or more actual parameters of the sequence, __and wherein the adapted mode mapping information is signaled using at least one high level syntax element__.

5. (Previously presented) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the adapted mode mapping information is signaled using at least one high level syntax element.

7. (Previously presented) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the adapted mode mapping information is updated after encoding one or more pictures of the sequence.

8. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the actual parameters are determined from at least one of coding information for one or more previously coded pictures in the sequence, a selected subset of a set of adapted mode mapping information relating to at least a portion of the sequence, one or more partial encoding passes for the picture, statistics of one or more pictures in the sequence, statistics of one or more portions of the one or more pictures in the sequence, and statistics of the sequence, __and wherein the picture is a currently coded picture__.

9. (Currently amended) A method, comprising: encoding (740, 970) mode mapping information for a mapping between values of a mode index and modes available to encode at least a portion of a picture in a sequence of pictures __using an encoder__, wherein the mode mapping information is adapted responsive to one or more actual parameters of the sequence (740, 940, 960), __and wherein the adapted mode mapping information is signaled using at least one high level syntax element (740, 975)__.

10. (Previously presented) The method of claim 9, wherein the picture is a currently coded picture, and the actual parameters comprise coding information for one or more previously coded pictures in the sequence (940, 960).

11. (Original) The method of claim 10, wherein the coding information comprises at least one of a frequency of mode usage, at least one spatial resolution, and at least one temporal resolution.

12. (Previously presented) The method of claim 9, wherein at least a portion of the sequence is encoded into a resultant bitstream, and the adapted mode mapping information is signaled in the resultant bitstream (740, 975).

13. (Previously presented) The method of claim 9, wherein the adapted mode mapping information is signaled using at least one high level syntax element (740, 975).

14. (Original) The method of claim 13, wherein the high level syntax element is comprised in at least one of a slice header, a sequence parameter set, a picture parameter set, a network abstraction layer unit header, and a supplemental enhancement information message.

15. (Previously presented) The method of claim 9, wherein the adapted mode mapping information is updated after encoding one or more pictures of the sequence (550, 960).

16. (Currently amended) The method of claim 9, wherein the picture is a currently coded picture, and the actual parameters are determined from at least one of coding information for one or more previously coded pictures in the sequence, a selected subset of a set of adapted mode mapping information relating to at least a portion of the sequence, one or more partial encoding passes for the picture, statistics of one or more pictures in the sequence, statistics of one or more portions of the one or more pictures in the sequence, and statistics of the sequence (940, 960).

17. (Currently amended) An apparatus, comprising: a decoder (400) for decoding mode mapping information for a mapping between values of a mode index and modes available to decode at least a portion of a picture in a sequence of pictures, wherein the mode mapping information is adapted responsive to one or more actual parameters of the sequence, __and wherein the adapted mode mapping information is signaled using at least one high level syntax element__.

23. (Previously presented) The apparatus of claim 17, wherein the adapted mode mapping information is updated after decoding one or more pictures of the sequence.

24. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 17, wherein the actual parameters are determined from at least one of coding information for one or more previously coded pictures in the sequence, a selected subset of a set of adapted mode mapping information relating to at least a portion of the sequence, statistics of one or more pictures in the sequence, statistics of one or more portions of the one or more pictures in the sequence, and statistics of the sequence, __and wherein the picture is a currently coded picture__.

25. (Currently amended) A method, comprising: decoding (820, 1030) mode mapping information for a mapping between values of a mode index and modes available to decode at least a portion of a picture in a sequence of pictures __using a decoder__, wherein the mode mapping information is adapted responsive to one or more actual parameters of the sequence, __and wherein the adapted mode mapping information is signaled using at least one high level syntax element__.

31. (Previously presented) The method of claim 25, wherein the adapted mode mapping information is updated after decoding one or more pictures of the sequence.

32. (Currently amended) The method of claim 25, wherein the actual parameters are determined from at least one of coding information for one or more previously coded pictures in the sequence, a selected subset of a set of adapted mode mapping information relating to at least a portion of the sequence, statistics of one or more pictures in the sequence, statistics of one or more portions of the one or more pictures in the sequence, and statistics of the sequence, __and wherein the picture is a currently coded picture__.

33. (Currently amended) A __non-transitory__ computer-readable storage media having video signal data encoded thereupon, comprising: mode mapping information for a mapping between values of a mode index and modes available to encode at least a portion of a picture in a sequence of pictures, wherein the mode mapping information is adapted responsive to one or more actual parameters of the __sequence__, __and wherein the adapted mode mapping information is signaled using at least one high level syntax element__.
